|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Death Star Gunner (V)]]; it was replaced by [[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-deathstargunner-pre.gif]]), which shows this text, as does the Master List slip.
* '''Original''' ([[Death Star Gunner (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 08: “While on Death Star: cancels opponent's game text on your non-docking bay Death Star sites, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and, during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ Superlaser.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee news post "Errata to Death Star Gunner (V)/Rebel Tech (V)" (17 June 2010, “Effective immediately”) gave the new text in full (errata slip 1•08E): “While on Death Star: cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites' game text, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to ▲ Superlaser.”<ref name="src-S2">Players Committee news post "Errata to Death Star Gunner (V)/Rebel Tech (V)" (Rogue4), 17 June 2010. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025220/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=102:errata-to-death-star-gunner-vrebel-tech-v&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref> The Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata) (by 27 August 2012) has the same text.<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-5; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announcement date not found). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints it again (slip marked E), after the card list had shown PC-E2; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Death Star Gunner (V) (Errata 2)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) wrote the ▲ out as “take a Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, adding the article “a” (tooltip dated “Errata Text - June 18th, 2010”): “While on Death Star: cancels Force drain bonuses from Death Star sites' game text, your [A New Hope] Epic Event total is cumulatively +2, and during your deploy phase, may place this character in Used Pile to take a Superlaser into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”<ref name="cl-1210_8-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
